build_decision_tree_classifier: build a DecisionTreeClassifier with gini or log_loss criterion on iris dataset
build_decision_tree_regressor: build a DecisionTreeRegressor with squared_error or poisson criterion on diabetes dataset
test_feature_importances: test feature importances extraction from fitted DecisionTreeClassifier on classification data
test_cost_complexity_pruning: test cost_complexity_pruning_path to generate ccp_alphas and prune a fitted decision tree
test_sparse_matrix_input: test decision tree fitting and prediction with sparse CSR and CSC matrix inputs
test_missing_value_handling: test decision tree native handling of NaN missing values during fit and predict
test_pickle_serialization: test pickling and unpickling of fitted DecisionTreeClassifier preserves predictions
test_extra_tree_random_splits: test ExtraTreeClassifier and ExtraTreeRegressor with random split selection
